verdict.rationale: Puzzle's help center says you can export a full general ledger and financial statements, on cash or accrual basis, in Excel, CSV and PDF. That covers the core accounting record in open formats you can take elsewhere. Missing for 10: evidence that non-ledger data (invoices, attachments, categorization rules, chart of accounts) can also be exported, documented account-closure or offboarding steps, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the exports are complete.
